title: fallback-consume-start uses an un-timed ack; a lost ack latches isEnteringFallbackRef and blocks fallback, and a late ack starts a player regardless of state
test: tests/browser/media-flow.spec.mjs: 'a relay start the server never answers ends its connecting state with a reason and is stopped once, not retried in a loop', 'a connection that drops while the relay start is unanswered starts it again on the new connection' and 'a relay start answered after Leave Room and a new join leaves the new session alone and sends no stop' (chromium); tests/timedAck.test.js: 'the raw acknowledgement is resolved unchanged, whatever its shape', 'the request is emitted once, before the helper returns, with its payload and an ack', 'a missing answer rejects with a timeout error after 10 s by default, and the helper cleans up', 'timeoutMs sets the wait', 'a connection that drops first rejects with a disconnect error, and nothing is emitted again', 'an answer that arrives after the timeout or the disconnect is ignored', 'a disconnect after the answer changes nothing', 'nothing is emitted while the socket is disconnected, so nothing is buffered into a later connection', 'the request is never retried, whatever the answer or the silence', 'a socket that throws on emit rejects the request and leaves nothing behind', 'WatchView sends fallback-consume-start only through the timed helper, never raw or through socketRequest'; tests/viewerSession.test.js: 'the session in progress can be asked for without beginning one', 'a { ok: true, fallbackAvailable: true } answer reaches the success path and keeps the claim', 'the answer is classified as it was: only an error refuses, any other answer starts', 'a stale answer delivered after a newer start was emitted and acknowledged sends no fallback-consume-stop', 'a stale answer with no newer start sends exactly one stop, on the same connection', 'a late answer after Leave Room starts no player and sends no stop', 'a start that is given up on by exitFallbackMode is stopped once, and its late answer sends nothing more', 'exitFallbackMode stops only the latest claim, and only once', 'a missing answer ends the connecting state after the timeout, stops the start once, and a later start is sent', 'a timeout after a newer start sends no stop', 'a connection that drops before the answer sends no stop, clears the flag, and resumes on reconnect', 'no stop goes out on a connection other than the one the start used', 'no start is attempted for a viewer that is not joined, or whose room ended', 'WatchView sends the fallback start through the ledger and ties every stop and flag reset to the viewer session'
proof: Browser repro: an init-script WebSocket subclass makes the room look like an OBS room to a tunnel-origin viewer (the join-room answer is rewritten to ingestMode 'obs' with a producer, so the relay-first path sends fallback-consume-start by itself) and decides what answers that request (the server's { ok: true, fallbackAvailable: true }, held back, or never). On the unchanged WatchView (lane/watch 3b574aa plus the new modules, run-e2e.cjs on the lane's own ports; scratchpad watch-TASK-091-before-e2e.txt) all three failed: (1) with the answer never coming, 'Relay Mode (unknown) - connecting' was still on screen after 20 s more (toHaveCount(0) received 1); (2) after the connection dropped with the start unanswered, the reconnect rejoined the room but never sent a second fallback-consume-start (received 1, expected 2): isEnteringFallbackRef was still true; (3) after Leave Room and a new Join no relay mode appeared (the flag Leave Room never cleared kept the new start from being sent). After the fix all three pass, 3 of 3 with --repeat-each=3 (watch-TASK-091-after-repeat.txt): the connecting state ends 10 s after the start with 'Relay mode did not respond in time. Try again in a moment.', the Watch Stream button is back, exactly one fallback-consume-start and one fallback-consume-stop (the compensation, ordered after the start on the same connection) are sent and nothing asks again by itself; the dropped connection sends no stop and the reconnect sends the second start on the new connection, which is answered and shows Relay Mode; the first start's answer released after the second was answered sends no fallback-consume-stop and leaves Relay Mode and the Try WebRTC control in place. Unit: the new modules had no old code to run against (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND); the two source guards on WatchView failed on the unchanged file (watch-TASK-091-before-unit.txt). Fix: src/lib/timedAck.mjs, emitWithTimedAck(socket, event, payload, { timeoutMs = 10000 }), emits once and resolves with the raw answer (no reading of success or ok), rejects with SocketNotConnectedError without emitting while disconnected, AckTimeoutError after the timeout and AckDisconnectError on 'disconnect', removes its timer and listener on settle, ignores a late answer, never retries and never calls socket.connect(). subscriptionLedger.emitClaimedStart (claim and emit in one synchronous block; the relay start already used it) now sits on that helper and keeps its 15 s relay default; SocketNotConnectedError moved to timedAck.mjs and is re-exported. src/lib/fallbackStart.mjs, beginFallbackStart, sends the start as the 'fallback' kind through emitClaimedStart and settles it to started (the answer came while the viewer that asked still wants it and holds no error: the existing classification), rejected (an error: claim released, no stop), stale (the viewer left, the room ended, the session was replaced or the start was given up: stop through releaseSubscription only if ledger.canRelease, else nothing), timeout (same compensation, a stop on the same connection is ordered after the server's possible processing of the start) and disconnected (claim released, no stop). viewerSession.current() hands out the session in progress. WatchView.enterFallbackMode captures the session and the joined room code at entry (no codeInput fallback; no start for an unjoined viewer or an ended room), keeps the claim in fallbackClaimRef, and the answer is acted on only if the claim, the session, the joined state, the room code and the terminal flag still match; timeout and refusal latch fallbackStartRejectedRef, a disconnect or a start refused while disconnected does not and sets fallbackResumeRef so the reconnect rejoin calls enterFallbackMode again; isEnteringFallbackRef is cleared in a finally block (only by the start that still owns the view) and by dropFallbackClaim in Leave Room (before its first await), room-ended, the terminal transport-failed branch, onReconnect and unmount; exitFallbackMode releases the claim through releaseSubscription instead of emitting a stop unconditionally. Verification: whole media-flow spec 26/26 (watch-TASK-091-after-media-flow.txt), ui-semantics.spec.mjs 93/93, node --test tests/timedAck.test.js tests/viewerSession.test.js tests/subscriptionLedger.test.js tests/playbackAttempt.test.js 60/60; npm run lint and typecheck clean; npm test 1510/1510.
